---
title: "No color-scheme toggle when the dark brand file is ignored"
format: html
brand:
  light: united-brand.yml
  dark: comment-only-dark-brand.yml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'comment-only-dark-brand\.yml has no content and will be ignored'
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - []
        - ["link.quarto-color-alternate"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        -
          - 'quarto-color-scheme-toggle'
---

A comment-only dark brand file is ignored, so the page has a single light mode and must not emit any toggle markup or toggle script.
